The city

![Le MuMa et le Signal de nuit. © Florian Kleinefenn](https://www.muma-lehavre.fr/sites/default/files/styles/280x88/public/thumbnails/image/vh_muma-nuit_0.jpg?itok=dlw9PK3h "Le MuMa et le Signal de nuit. © Florian Kleinefenn")

Located at the mouth of the Seine, the City of Le Havre, classified a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2005, had always been a strategic point for access inland to Paris.
